title: chore(packages): LICENSE for the 14 published packages without one
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9WCCBXqjegEWeDz1zCg9E3U)_

Fixes #26095

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The second half of #26095's publishing-metadata sweep. #26198 landed the publint/attw reading, the manifest repairs and the 18 missing READMEs; this PR adds the one thing it held back: a `LICENSE` in the 14 published packages that had none. It was split off because the 14 copies are 2,828 lines on their own and the two halves together crossed the 3,000-line threshold.

## Why these 14 shipped no licence

npm packs a package's own `LICENSE` whatever its `files` whitelist says (`scripts/check-published-files.mjs` records that measurement in `ALWAYS_PACKED`), and nothing in `scripts/` or `.github/workflows/` copies the repository's root `LICENSE` into a package at publish time. So these 14 tarballs declared `"license": "Apache-2.0"` and carried no licence text:

`@objectstack/account`, `@objectstack/console`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/sdui-parser`, `@objectstack/service-datasource`, `@objectstack/service-messaging`, `@objectstack/setup`, `@objectstack/skills`, `@objectstack/studio`, `@objectstack/trigger-api`, `@objectstack/trigger-record-change`, `@objectstack/trigger-schedule`, `@objectstack/verify`.

Each new file is a byte-for-byte copy of the root `LICENSE` — the same file, by hash, that the other 59 published packages already carry. No `files` entry changes: a `LICENSE` listed there would be an unregistered extra entry to `check:published-files`, and it is packed anyway.

After this PR, re-counted on `origin/main` at `f2e70836`: all 73 published packages outside `ui/` ship both a `LICENSE` and a `README.md`.

## Verification

Measured at head `03dee064` on `origin/main` `f2e70836`.

- **LICENSE census:** 59 of 73 published packages carried a `LICENSE` before. After this PR, 73 of 73 carry one, and 73 of 73 carry a `README.md`. `npm pack --dry-run` on `packages/console`, one of the 14, now lists `LICENSE` (11.4 kB) next to `README.md`.
- All 14 files have the same md5 as the root `LICENSE`.
- `turbo run build` over all 73 published packages: **72 of 72 tasks successful**. The 73rd package has no build task.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 61 families for this diff. The run record reconciles with `--ran` at **61 accounted: 60 run, 0 unrun**, and all 60 exit 0.
- One family is NOT MEASURED: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`. On a shallow clone it refuses its own prerequisite with exit 3, its reserved code. Its real scan, `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs`, exits 0. CI has the full history.
- Gates worth naming for this diff, all exit 0: `check:published-files` (confirms the 14 `files` lists didn't need to change), `check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main` and `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`.

## Changeset

One `patch` in `.changeset/26095-license-files.md`, naming the 14 packages whose tarball gains the file.
